focus.display: Referral: In-office evaluation and endodontic treatment, tooth #19

note.text: This is the ONLY Task for this referral episode — same single-Task design established for UC01/UC02/UC03 (one Coordination Task per Request; Task.output absorbs fulfillment artifacts). focus points at the referral ServiceRequest from the start (there is no PA cycle preceding it — commercial coverage requires no PA). businessStatus is 'referral-sent' at this I1 snapshot; owner is intentionally NOT set yet (it is set for the first time at I2 when Barton Springs Dental Group accepts the referral and books the appointment). status is in-progress, not completed — the Task closes only when the referral itself closes at Interaction 4 (not built this pass). This same Task (same id) is updated, not replaced, at I2.
